name: CameraMode
meaning: Values of g_camMode 0x6e4383 as dispatched by Camera_Update (jump table 0x55a6d9). Requesters come from the Wolf state descriptor byte [3] dump and Robot_UpdateCamera 0x45e62e.

name: CAM_FOLLOW
meaning: Normal follow (Camera_UpdateFollow); 194 Wolf states; dist 610

name: CAM_LOOK
meaning: First-person look on the view button (Camera_UpdateLook), dist 0

name: CAM_FOLLOW_RUN
meaning: Camera_UpdateFollow with run parameters (dist 370, focal 230); WOLF_ST_RUN_START/RUN/RUN_AIR

name: CAM_ROCKET
meaning: Camera_UpdateRocket; WOLF_ST_ROCKET_FLY/ROCKET_CRASH

name: CAM_FIXED_LOOKAT
meaning: Camera_UpdateFixedLookAt, eye frozen; DIE_BLOWN_AWAY, ROCKET_MOUNT, ROCKET_IGNITE

name: CAM_DIRECTED
meaning: Camera_UpdateDirected; Wolf descriptor values 0xD..0x14 (elastic pull, cover, sidle, fishing, deaths, caught by Sam)

name: CAM_ROBOT
meaning: Camera_UpdateFollow with dist 230 / focal 284; set by Robot_UpdateCamera 0x45e62e (Camera_SetMode(6,0))

name: CAM_SCRIPTED
meaning: static scripted pose (Camera_UpdateScriptedHold)

name: CAM_SCRIPT_RETURN
meaning: 1 s eased return from a script (Camera_UpdateScriptReturn)

name: CAM_SCRIPT_BLEND_IN
meaning: eased blend from follow into a script (Camera_UpdateScriptBlendIn)

name: CAM_SCRIPT_TO_SCRIPT
meaning: eased blend between scripts (Camera_UpdateScriptToScript)

name: CAM_ORBIT_UNUSED
meaning: Has a parameter record but Camera_Update never dispatches it; its update 0x5591f2 is unreferenced

name: CAM_SAM_CHASE
meaning: Level-1 Sam chase camera (Camera_UpdateSamChase)

name: CAM_REQ_DIR_BEHIND
meaning: Wolf::UpdateCamera req 0xd: mode 5, no pad rotation, yaw behind the facing

name: CAM_REQ_DIR_COVER
meaning: req 0xe: restriction on, yaw from the cover target side

name: CAM_REQ_DIR_CLIMB
meaning: req 0xf: pitch follows vertical velocity (0xd56 up / 0x2aa down)

name: CAM_REQ_DIR_HIGH
meaning: req 0x10: pitch 0x200

name: CAM_REQ_DIR_FRONT
meaning: req 0x11: faces the Wolf, aim 300 ahead, pitch 0x2aa

name: CAM_REQ_DIR_HOLD
meaning: req 0x12-0x14: keep the current camera rotation

name: CAM_REQ_DIR_HOLD2
meaning: req 0x13 (same case as 0x12)

name: CAM_REQ_DIR_HOLD3
meaning: req 0x14 (same case as 0x12)

name: CAM_REQ_NONE
meaning: camOverride 0xff: use the state descriptor's camMode (Wolf::UpdateCamera)
